questions.q: As of 2025, which country grows the most cocoa beans for chocolate?
questions.fact: Côte d'Ivoire, also called Ivory Coast, grows more than a third of the world's cocoa.

questions.q: As of 2025, which country grows the most vanilla?
questions.fact: Vanilla first came from Mexico, but Madagascar now grows most of the world's supply.

questions.q: As of 2025, which country grows the most avocados?
questions.fact: The state of Michoacán grows most of Mexico's avocados.

questions.q: As of 2025, which country grows the most saffron?
questions.fact: Iran grows around 90 percent of the world's saffron.

questions.q: As of 2025, which country exports the most bananas?
questions.fact: India grows more bananas than any other country, but it eats most of them at home.

questions.q: As of 2025, which country grows the most corn?
questions.fact: Much of the US corn crop is used to feed animals and make fuel, not for eating off the cob.

questions.q: As of 2025, which country grows the most potatoes?
questions.fact: China and India together grow more than a third of the world's potatoes.

questions.q: As of 2025, which country grows the most oranges?
questions.fact: Much of Brazil's orange crop is made into orange juice for other countries.

questions.q: As of 2025, which country grows the most tea?
questions.fact: India and Kenya are also among the biggest tea growers.
